prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original medieval RPG low-resolution pixel-art PROP REVIEW BOARD, uniform opaque neutral grey background. Three separate object groups, single row, ample spacing. Chunky square pixels, dark selective outlines, muted undyed cream wool, brown wood, linen cord, three-tone shading. LEFT: TWO modest household winter wool bundles tied with DIFFERENT distinct simple knots, one loop and one crossed tie, as identification proposals not clan emblems. MIDDLE: ONE separate modest wool bundle with a plain small linen tie/tag reserved for care, no medical cross and no patient. RIGHT: ONE plain wooden buyer price tally paddle and small empty weighing pan, no numbers, no writing, no gold or wool pile. Show finite and distinct household reserves, care-promised bundle and buyer-offer prop. NOT three states or duplicated inventories, not a signed sale, allocation or delivery. No herd, full shed, unlimited wool, replenishment, forced sale or lost winter warmth erased. This is appearance reference only; actual labels and quantities use narrative state.
